name: LeaseAbstractForm
tagline: Abstract every lease with a clause behind every value – and a second pair of eyes on every number.
description: A complete lease abstraction and QA app for Power Apps and Power Pages: template-driven sectioned abstract, clause reference, page and excerpt per value, blind dual-key re-keying of money fields, four-eyes verification, weighted completeness scores, cross-field consistency checks and a clause index – working in demo mode the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Configurable abstraction template (section, field, type, importance, choice options)
Clause reference, page, source document and excerpt per value
Clause reference rule (critical / required / all / off)
Dual-key verification – verifier re-keys money (or date / critical) values blind
Four-eyes rule – abstractor cannot verify their own entry
Weighted completeness and verified scores per lease and portfolio
Cross-field checks: dates, term, rent vs area × rate, deposit months, invalid values, missing template rows, overdue
Bulk verify and dispute with per-row rule checks
New lease abstract from the template, missing fields, custom fields
Undo, CSV export, read-only, phone bottom bar, keyboard and screen-reader support
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
